item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the national-security determination that increased tariffs are necessary to adjust imports; this is a statutory predicate determination, although the tariff change is specified elsewhere.","evidence":"I have determined that it is necessary to increase the previously described steel and aluminum tariffs to adjust the imports"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President states a predictive policy judgment about the expected benefits of increasing tariffs; this segment neither changes a tariff nor directs an official to impose one.","evidence":"increasing the previously imposed tariffs will provide greater support to these industries and reduce or eliminate the national security threat"},{"segment_id":"3","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently determines the specific tariff increase, covered imports, rate, and effective time, with later provisions supplying implementation details.","evidence":"increase the tariff rate for imports of steel articles and derivative steel articles, and aluminum articles and derivative aluminum articles, from 25 percent ad valorem to 50 percent ad valorem"},{"segment_id":"4","code":3,"rationale":"The President directly modifies existing tariffs from 25 to 50 percent and establishes when that legally binding rate applies to entered goods.","evidence":"the tariffs proclaimed by Proclamation 9704, as amended; Proclamation 9705, as amended; Proclamation 9980, as amended; Proclamation 10895; and Proclamation 10896 are modified"},{"segment_id":"5","code":3,"rationale":"The provision itself fixes the tariff treatment and required foreign-trade-zone status of covered articles upon entry for consumption.","evidence":"may be admitted only under \"privileged foreign status\" as defined in 19 CFR 146.41"},{"segment_id":"6","code":3,"rationale":"The President immediately amends an executive order to exempt specified articles from additional tariffs, directly determining their tariff liability from the stated effective time.","evidence":"shall not be subject to additional tariffs on that article pursuant to the actions listed in section 2(b) or 2(c) of this order"},{"segment_id":"7","code":3,"rationale":"The provision itself subjects the specified non-aluminum and non-steel content to applicable tariffs, directly establishing tariff liability.","evidence":"shall be subject to tariffs pursuant to Executive Order 14257"},{"segment_id":"8","code":4,"rationale":"This segment inseparably combines immediate tariff scope and rate rules and a no-drawback rule, a mandate for CBP to issue consequential compliance guidance, and discretionary monitoring, reporting, and implementation authority.","evidence":"No drawback shall be available with respect to the duties imposed pursuant to this proclamation."},{"segment_id":"9","code":4,"rationale":"This segment combines discretionary agency implementation and possible HTSUS modification with an immediate presidential supersession of inconsistent prior directives.","evidence":"is superseded to the extent of such inconsistency"}]}
